svg.title: LoRA rank study
svg.desc: Accuracy by LoRA rank for DistilRoBERTa on financial news tweets, five seeds per setting, mean with 95% interval. rank 4 (0.81% of weights trained): 82.20% [81.17, 83.23]. rank 8 (0.90% of weights trained): 83.55% [82.87, 84.23]. rank 16 (1.08% of weights trained): 84.08% [83.32, 84.83]. rank 32 (1.44% of weights trained): 84.42% [83.31, 85.53]. rank 64 (2.16% of weights trained): 84.56% [83.62, 85.50]. Full fine-tuning: 86.85% [85.98, 87.73]. Gains between neighboring ranks: +1.35 pp (p = 0.004), +0.52 pp (p = 0.001), +0.35 pp (p = 0.14), +0.14 pp (p = 0.35). Gains past rank 16 are not significant.
